text: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, prorated by start date. Unused leave up to 5 days may be carried over into Q1 of the following year with manager approval.
Sick leave of up to 12 days per year is provided for personal illness or medical appointments. Absences exceeding 3 consecutive working days require a registered medical practitioner certificate.
Parental leave grants 26 weeks of paid maternity leave and 4 weeks of paid paternity leave for eligible employees who have completed at least 80 working days with the organization.
Core working hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM local time. Employees must log attendance daily in the HRIS portal and notify their reporting manager at least 2 hours prior to an unplanned absence.
Public holidays follow the regional office calendar published every December. Employees required to work on a gazetted holiday receive compensatory time off within 30 days.
Bereavement leave of 5 paid working days is granted upon the loss of an immediate family member, including spouse, children, parents, or siblings.
Unapproved absence for 5 or more consecutive working days without communication will be treated as voluntary abandonment of employment after written notice.
Sabbatical leave of up to 8 weeks unpaid may be requested after 4 years of continuous service, subject to departmental workload and VP approval.
Half-day leave requests must be submitted at least 24 hours in advance and cover either the morning session (9:00 AM to 1:30 PM) or afternoon session (1:30 PM to 6:00 PM).
Jury duty and statutory civic obligations are granted as paid administrative leave upon submission of official court summons to Human Resources.
Monthly base salaries are disbursed on the last working day of each month via direct bank transfer. Payslips and tax deduction breakdowns are accessible through the payroll portal.
Annual performance bonuses are discretionary and tied to both company revenue targets and individual appraisal ratings achieved during the fiscal review cycle.
Comprehensive group health insurance covers employees, spouses, and up to two dependent children from day one of employment, including hospitalization and maternity benefits.
Employees are eligible for a 5 percent employer matching contribution toward the retirement provident fund upon completion of the six-month probationary period.
Business travel expenses, including economy airfare, hotel lodging up to approved city caps, and meals, are reimbursed within 15 business days of submitting itemized receipts.
An annual learning and development stipend of $1,000 is available for job-related certifications, conference passes, and technical courses approved by the department head.
Referral bonuses of $1,500 are paid to employees who refer candidates hired into full-time roles, disbursed after the referred hire completes 90 days of service.
Overtime compensation applies strictly to non-exempt staff working beyond 40 hours per week with prior written authorization from their supervisor.
Salary revisions take effect every April following the annual compensation benchmarking and merit review process.
Relocation assistance covers one-way household goods shipment and up to 14 days of temporary corporate housing for roles requiring inter-city transfer.
All personnel must treat colleagues, clients, and vendors with dignity and respect. Harassment, discrimination, or bullying based on gender, race, religion, age, or disability is strictly prohibited.
Employees must disclose any actual or potential conflict of interest, including outside employment, board memberships, or financial stakes in competing or supplier businesses.
Offering or accepting gifts, hospitality, or payments exceeding $50 in value to influence business decisions violates our anti-bribery policy and triggers disciplinary action.
Confidential company records, customer data, proprietary algorithms, and unreleased product roadmaps must never be shared externally without an executed non-disclosure agreement.
Workplace substance abuse, including possession or consumption of alcohol or illegal drugs on company premises during business hours, is grounds for immediate termination.
Whistleblowers reporting suspected fraud, safety violations, or ethical misconduct through the anonymous ethics hotline are strictly protected against retaliation.
Only authorized corporate spokespersons may issue statements to the press or represent official company positions on social media platforms.
Insider trading is illegal; employees in possession of material non-public information are barred from trading company securities during designated blackout windows.
Dress code during standard office days is smart casual, while formal business attire is expected when hosting external clients or executive leadership.
Violations of the Code of Conduct are investigated impartially by the Ethics Committee and may result in verbal warning, suspension, or dismissal.
Hybrid employees are expected to work from their assigned office hub at least 3 days per week, including mandatory team collaboration Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Company-issued laptops must have full-disk encryption enabled, automatic screen lock set to 5 minutes, and endpoint security agents active at all times.
Employees working remotely must connect via the corporate VPN before accessing internal repositories, staging databases, or HR systems.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory across all corporate email, cloud storage, and single sign-on accounts; sharing credentials is strictly forbidden.
A one-time home office setup allowance of $400 is provided to remote-eligible staff for ergonomic chairs, monitors, or high-speed internet upgrades.
Installing unapproved third-party software, browser extensions, or pirated utilities on company hardware is prohibited to prevent malware infection.
Suspected phishing emails, lost devices, or security breaches must be reported to the InfoSec team within 1 hour of discovery.
International remote work is permitted for up to 20 business days per year only in pre-approved tax jurisdictions with prior written clearance from HR and Legal.
Customer personally identifiable information must never be downloaded onto local personal USB drives or unencrypted home computers.
All corporate hardware remains company property and must be maintained in good working condition with routine OS security patches installed within 7 days of release.
New hires must submit government-issued identification, educational certificates, and signed offer letters at least 3 business days prior to their joining date.
The standard probationary period for all new full-time hires is 6 months, with formal midpoint feedback at 90 days and confirmation review at 180 days.
During week one, new employees must complete mandatory compliance modules covering data privacy, workplace safety, and anti-harassment.
Each new joiner is paired with a departmental onboarding buddy for the first 30 days to assist with system setup, team workflows, and culture orientation.
Employees resigning from the company must serve a 60-day notice period unless waived in writing by the department head and Human Resources.
Prior to the final working day, departing staff must complete knowledge transfer documentation and obtain clearance sign-offs from IT, Finance, and Administration.
All company laptops, access badges, corporate credit cards, and physical keys must be returned on or before the last working day to release full and final settlement.
IT revokes all single sign-on, VPN, email, and repository access automatically at 6:00 PM local time on the employee's separation date.
Exit interviews are conducted by HR during the final week to gather confidential feedback on workplace experience and reasons for departure.
Full and final settlement, including encashment of eligible unused annual leave and experience letters, is processed within 30 days of separation clearance.
